correctness.rationale: The helper implements the inspectable exit contract end-to-end: PR-number validation, INTERVAL/QUIET_WINDOW/MAX_WAIT defaults, allow-list loading with [bot] stripping, pre/post head SHA checks, GraphQL snapshot parsing, and RESULT=/HEAD= emissions for CONVERGED, QUIET_ELAPSED, TIMEOUT, SHA_CHANGED, and API_ERROR with documented exit codes. Bats mocks exercise the main branches. One meaningful contract gap: convergence gates on all_terminal && unresolved_count==0 but never requires has_participating>0, so a PR with zero participating allow-listed bots can exit CONVERGED on the first poll. Secondary gaps: reviews/threads/comments are capped at first/last 100 without pagination, and any non-PENDING review on the current head (including DISMISSED) counts as terminal.

quality.rationale: Core deliverables are clear and repo-consistent: shell script with logging.sh fallback, documented env defaults, canonical allow-list with normalization comments, pr-resolve-all.md settle-window section preferring the helper while preserving the 360s time-based fallback, and AI_REPO_GUIDE.md entries. Check wiring (010, 105, 142) follows existing patterns. Deductions for a ~300-line monolithic script with inline jq instead of extracted filters, a bats suite wrapped in a legacy _legacy_body harness rather than idiomatic per-case tests, and unrelated diff churn (040-file-content.sh AGENTS handshake workaround; compliance fixture v19→v20 bumps) that dilutes focus.

process.rationale: Required artifacts and doc-sync surfaces are present and the prompt explicitly preserves the time-based fallback while deferring #321. However the diff includes noticeable out-of-scope edits: compliance fixture version bumps and a 040-file-content.sh workaround for AGENTS.md handshake detection, neither required by opfit-326. Objective evidence also flags scope:compliance_fixtures as warn. Core helper/allow-list/test wiring remains focused but process discipline is only partial.

reliability.rationale: Verification wiring is credible: scripts/checks/142-pr-resolve-all-poll-smoke.sh invokes run_bats_check on scripts/tests/pr-resolve-all-poll.bats; objective bash_n_poll_helper and lint_poll_helper passed and test_wiring matched 2/2. The bats suite mock-tests missing/invalid args, SHA_CHANGED, CONVERGED, QUIET_ELAPSED, and TIMEOUT. Gaps: no mock coverage for API_ERROR paths (missing allowlist, gh/auth/graphql failures), no test for zero-participating-bot premature CONVERGED, and bats_poll_helper was skipped in objective grading so runtime pass is unverified in this bundle.

uncertainty_notes: bats_poll_helper and full_test_sh were skipped in objective-grade.json; subjective reliability assumes mock-gh tests are structurally sound but not runtime-verified in this bundle.
Production behavior of premature CONVERGED when no bots have participated is inferred from diff logic (has_participating parsed but unused) rather than exercised by tests.
